MOVE below 80 is calm, 80-120 is moderate uncertainty, and 150+ is high stress; 93.89 is moderate. SOFR is a secured overnight funding rate, not unsecured bank funding. NFCI below zero indicates looser-than-average broad financial conditions; -0.459 is the latest returned weekly observation for Oct 30, not a live reading.

Fed & Policy Watch
  • The Board's November calendar lists no FOMC decision this month; minutes from the Oct 27-28 meeting are scheduled Wed Nov 18 at 2:00 PM ET. The December calendar lists the Dec 8-9 meeting, with statement/decision Dec 9 at 2:00 PM and press conference at 2:30 PM ET.
  • Selected Fed statistical releases verified from each Board row's own date list: H.15 Thu Nov 5 at 4:15 PM, H.4.1 Thu Nov 5 at 4:30 PM, and H.8 Fri Nov 6 at 4:15 PM. Latest observations: SOFR 3.97% effective Nov 3, NFCI -0.459 for the week ending Oct 30, MOVE 93.89 and official 10-year Treasury close 4.90% on Nov 4.
  • These are lagged funding, financial-conditions and yield measures, not live quotes. No Fed policy action is scheduled today in the checked Board calendar.
Omissions and Watch
  • Calendar conflict check: the NY Fed lists Personal Income and the PCE Deflator on Nov 25 at 8:30 AM ET without a period; BEA lists GDP (Second Estimate) and Corporate Profits for Q3 on that date, but schedules Personal Income and Outlays for October on Dec 2. These are retained as separately sourced entries; the NY Fed/BEA timing discrepancy is unresolved and the entries are not assumed to be the same release. The NY Fed lists Advance International Trade in Goods and Trade balance on Nov 4 at 8:30 AM, while Census uses the distinct title U.S. International Trade in Goods and Services; that Nov 4 timing is elapsed, and the titles do not support duplicating or merging a future row.
  • Cutoff filter: Nov 4 calendar events, including the standard EIA petroleum report and the NY Fed trade items, are elapsed and omitted. EIA verifies the next petroleum report as Thu Nov 12 at noon for the week ending Nov 6, rather than treating it as a standard Wednesday event. Natural gas is standard Thu at 10:30 AM, with the Veterans Day exception Fri Nov 13 at 10:30 AM.
  • BLS.gov was not requested; per source-access instruction, NY Fed Economic Indicators Calendar is cited for BLS release dates/times. Chicago Fed NFCI data returned through Oct 30; its release-calendar page did not establish an ET time for a Chicago Fed release, so no Chicago Fed item is added as a timed event. Chicago Fed value is dated, not live.
  • Unmatched classifier items (Initial Claims, Productivity & Costs, GSCPI, Weekly Economic Index, Michigan preliminary survey and Philadelphia Fed survey) are provisionally Medium and explicitly flagged in their rows for review; classifier self-test passed. No impact overrides used.
  • No verified unscheduled policy or geopolitical watch item was established in this run; this is not a full review of headline risk. No exchange-specific market-structure or product-hours source was checked; ES=F is a generic continuous vendor quote, not a contract-bound execution reference. Check event updates, live liquidity and selected contract details before execution.
  • Sources checked: New York Fed November Economic Indicators Calendar; Federal Reserve Board November and December calendars, FOMC calendar and H.4.1 page; Census 2026 Economic Indicators Calendar; BEA schedule; Chicago Fed release calendar and NFCI data; Philadelphia Fed; NAR; TreasuryDirect auctions; EIA petroleum and natural gas schedules; New York Fed SOFR; U.S. Treasury daily yield curve; Yahoo Finance charts. Market charts are single-source vendor quotes, not official settlements.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
SPY closed Wednesday up 1.65%, while the generic ES=F quote is 0.25% below Wednesday's completed daily bar in early Thursday trade. The official 10Y close eased 5 bp to 4.90%; MOVE at 93.89 is in the moderate-uncertainty band and VIX closed at 16.61. Today's 8:30 AM claims and productivity data, 10:00 AM GSCPI, 10:30 AM EIA gas report, 11:30 AM bill bid deadlines and afternoon Fed releases are potential volatility windows. Friday's Employment Situation is High impact; CPI is scheduled Tuesday. Overnight price discovery remains event-sensitive: confirm direction with current rates, volatility and liquidity. Scenario framing only, not a trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess if Treasury yields reverse higher alongside expanding volatility, scheduled data materially reprice rates, or ES weakens without confirmation from rates, breadth or market depth. No unsupported levels or targets are supplied. Verify the intended contract, event updates and fresh quotes before execution.
